# What release.yml builds the sdist and wheel with, at exact versions: the
# frontend (build) and, because release.yml builds with --no-isolation, the
# backend (setuptools) too. With SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set to the commit time, the
# same tag gives a byte-identical wheel. The sdist is not byte-reproducible:
# setuptools writes the files' modification times into it.
#
# Dependabot proposes updates (see dependabot.yml); the build job in tests.yml
# builds with these same pins, so an update that breaks the build shows up on
# its pull request rather than at the next tag.
build==1.6.1
setuptools==84.0.0

# build's own dependencies
packaging==26.3
pyproject_hooks==1.3.3
tomli==2.4.1 ; python_version < "3.11"
